title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Program Tenure Factor in Renewal Rating
content:
**Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — residential renewal schedule, Lender-Placed Flood – Residential Mandatory Amount tier.** Program tenure factor: the program renewal rate per 100 is multiplied by 0.95 when the program has been in force 60 months or more, by 0.98 when it has been in force at least 24 but fewer than 60 months, and by 1.00 when it has been in force fewer than 24 months.

Months in force for a renewal are the whole calendar months from the program effective date to today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached.

| Months in force | Multiplier |
|---|---|
| Fewer than 24 | 1.00 |
| 24 to 59 | 0.98 |
| 60 or more | 0.95 |

**Edge cases (hypothetical dates).** A program effective on 15 May five years before a renewal falling on 15 May has 60 whole months in force and takes 0.95; on 14 May it has 59 and takes 0.98. A program effective on 31 January reaches a new whole month only on a day numbered 31, so on 28 February of the following year it counts 12 months, not 13.
